title: Meme Coin Launcher
tagline: A dapp that allows users to interact with a bot to launch cross chain enabled meme coins created with AI.

prizes.placement: Best Use Case to Enhance Memecoin Transparency
prizes.title: Best Use Case to Enhance Memecoin Transparency

description:
Meme Coin Launcher is a decentralized application (dapp) that allows users to create and launch cross-chain meme coins using AI. Through a chatbot interface, users can issue commands to generate meme coins. 

These coins can be deployed on two testnets: Sepolia Optimism Testnet, where all coins are cross-chain enabled using Layer Zero, and Galadriel Testnet. This platform streamlines the creation of meme coins, merging AI-driven creativity with blockchain technology for cross-chain functionality.
how_its_made:
The frontend of the dapp is powered by Next.js, ensuring a smooth and dynamic user experience. 
Galadriel is responsible for all AI-related functionalities, including generating the coin's name, symbol, description, marketing plan, and logo.
 
The meme bot is built using XMTP MessageKit, providing seamless interaction with users. Openframes/Frames JS is utilized to generate transaction frames for deploying coins, while 

Envio indexes smart contract data to power the dapp.

To enhance transparency, Sign protocol attestations and hooks are integrated, providing clear information on meme coin creation. 

Chainlink automation unlocks tokens from locked vaults, further boosting transparency and trust. 

Layer Zero is used for enabling cross-chain functionality and powering the bridge for seamless transfers across chains. 
For wallet connectivity, RainbowKit and WAGMI kit are employed, allowing users to connect wallets like Coinbase Wallet. The Converse app ,coinbase wallet and Metmask were  used for testing.
